name: Marie Unna Hereditary Hypotrichosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Marie Unna Hereditary Hypotrichosis Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Autosomal dominant inheritance pattern with affected family members
Sparse or absent scalp hair at birth with progressive coarse, wiry hair regrowth in childhood
Partial or complete loss of eyebrows and eyelashes
Reduced or absent body and axillary hair

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of autosomal dominant family history plus characteristic scalp hair pattern (sparse or absent at birth with coarse regrowth) is required for diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for mutations in the U2HR gene can confirm diagnosis.

other: Hair shaft abnormalities on microscopic examination showing pili torti and trichorrhexis nodosa

distinguishingFeatures: Usually autosomal dominant but lacks coarse wiry hair regrowth
Sudden onset with complete hair loss
No family history or characteristic hair regrowth pattern

redFlags: Sudden onset of complete hair loss
Associated systemic symptoms such as fever or weight loss
Signs of scarring alopecia or skin inflammation
